_comment: SemanticBridge (mvg-inatech/3d_bridge_segmentation): real TLS/MLS scans of 20 bridges,
9 classes, 245M points. Held-out test area is 5 bridges; validation is a spatial split
of the train area, so the test bridges stay untouched until final evaluation.
Any flag given on the command line overrides what is set here.
Why these values differ from the indoor domain:
block_size 20480   a bridge column spans far more points than a room column
column mode        bridges are horizontally long; column partitioning keeps the deck
and the structure beneath it in one block
pad_blocks false   bridge columns are mostly sparser than block_size, so padding them
up wasted 38% of all compute (measured). Needs its own cache dir.
cover_columns      a 2 m column over a bridge pier holds far more than block_size
points. Keeping one random subsample dropped 42% of labelled
points, unevenly: pillar kept 30%, abutment 45%, ground 67%.
focal_gamma 2.0    the distribution is extreme: ground 51% vs traffic_sign 0.10%
oversample_rare    does nothing unless class_weights in the model config are
num_epochs 150     only 15 training scenes; the 600-epoch indoor schedule spends most
of its budget at near-peak LR and never reaches the anneal in time
name: bridge
